Does that free mockup include the class booking system, payment button, member login, and calendar, or is it just a visual thing?
The free mockup shows the homepage layout and where those features would sit; it does not include working booking, payments, login, or calendar.
Oh, so it's just a picture then? What would it actually show me?

It would show how the homepage could be structured to guide visitors toward joining, booking a class, or contacting you, along with where the member login, payment, and calendar entry points would sit visually. So it's just a design, not something I can click on to see how the booking works?
No. It's one static homepage concept showing where those entry points would sit, not the screens or steps behind them.
So it's just a visual, then. How would that even help me?

It helps you see whether the homepage would present your classes, offers, and calls to action more clearly before you spend anything on development. Okay, I get it's about clarity. But how can I tell if the booking system itself would be easy to use if I can't even try it?
The free mockup cannot prove functionality; it only shows layout and placement. A working system requires scoped development.
So, I'd have to pay to see if the booking system even works?

The mockup is mainly a low-risk way to judge the direction before deciding whether a build is worth exploring. If you want, I can still send the homepage concept so you can at least see the layout first.
So, it's just a picture of where the buttons would be, not how they work?

Right, it shows where those actions would live on the homepage and how the page would guide someone toward them, but not the working flow behind them. If seeing that layout would still help, I can send it over.
Okay, so it's just the look of the homepage. Fine, send it over then.
What's the best email?
It's [REDACTED_EMAIL].
Just to confirm, [REDACTED_EMAIL] - is that right?
Yep, that's right.
Great, I'll send it there by the end of the day.
